title: How to check the morning news without letting it take over
dek: Reading the news first thing can set the tone for the whole day, so it helps to do it on purpose and with a limit.
keywords: how to read the news calmly
body: It has been a heavy stretch for news. Markets fell on Monday, oil prices jumped, and the headlines about conflict overseas keep coming. It would be easy to read all of it before even getting out of bed.

Most of us care about what is happening in the world and want to stay informed. Starting the day by scrolling headlines in the dark, though, can leave a worry that follows you into every conversation until lunch.

Changing the order can help. Get up, drink some water and make coffee first. Then sit down and read the news for about fifteen minutes from one or two sources you trust. When the time is up, close it.
That small limit lets you take the news seriously without letting it run your morning. You still know what is going on. You are just choosing when to let it in.
Tomorrow morning, try waiting until after your first cup of coffee to open the news, and give yourself a set amount of time to read it.
